name: Xianyun
notes: Both sources: 4pc Viridescent Venerer first, Burst > Skill, an ER or ATK% Sands, an ATK% Goblet, Crane's Echoing Call first. Circlet: ATK% (both) or Healing Bonus (Game8's healer build). Second sets: Ocean-Hued Clam and Song of Days Past (both name them); KQM adds Noblesse Oblige, Emblem of Severed Fate and Maiden Beloved. Game8 also gives a plunging DPS build (Long Night's Oath or Marechaussee Hunter, Vivid Notions first, CRIT Circlet), left out since both sources treat her as a support first. Her healing and the plunge buff scale with ATK (Burst heal 92.2% ATK + 578), so the scaling stat is ATK, with the Burst as the talent that matters. Goals are Game8's: ATK 3,500-4,000 (upper end) and ER 200 or above; KQM's ER depends on the weapon and teammates (190-300 solo Anemo, 140-210 with Xiao, 100-130 with Xiao and C6 Faruzan), so Game8's 200 is used. Partners are inferred (plunging-attack Anemo carries and their reaction teams); the sources give no team list.
